items.title: Arthur Vigne Interview, 1961-11-29
items.q: I used to play with him and practice with him.

ctx.x: Did your father ever help you with drums or did you start after that?

No, I started after him. In other words there was a friend of ours, a boy by the name of Louis Duguay. And he had a set of drums that he played with Fat Pichon. But in the meantime he wasn't so hot. And I don't know if I just had a feel for music at the time but I used to play with him and practice with him. And I could beat the drums better than he did. So when they get these boys instead of him playing I play the job. That's how I started playing. But I didn't play too long, you know I don't doubt if I played…
You don't have a piano in your home when you were a boy? Oh yeah, yeah, we always had a piano. Rehearsal.
